title: Red Sea Marine Services
description: rsms.com Red Sea Marine Services LLC is a ship management company based in Dubai, originally established in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia in 1987, serving the Bakri Group and major oil companies. Led by Managing Director Capt. Naushad Azad, it manages a fleet of crude, product and oil/chemical tankers plus LPG carriers, around 24 to 57 vessels and up to 2.4 million DWT, moving over 40 million tons of crude and fuel oil a year from Red Sea and Arabian Gulf terminals to worldwide destinations. The company was the first Saudi private firm certified to the ISM Code back in 1998 and holds ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 accreditation through ABS Group, with tankers routinely passing SIRE, CDI and TMSA audits. Services span ship management, STCW certified crew management, dry docking coordination, offshore support and port operations including the Yanbu port marine contract. It uses digital tools StratumFive and Viswa VEEMS for vessel tracking, energy efficiency and IMO compliance.
